name: Shri Mangal Dev Grah Mandir, Amalner
summary: Amalner’s living Mangal Dev temple — among the rare Indian shrines with a Mangal (Mars) murti.
famousFor: Rare Mangal Graha idol temple · mangal dosha shanti
mythology: Temples to Mangal Graha are scarce. At Amalner, a sindoor-smeared four-armed Mangal Dev is worshipped as Angaraka — planet of courage, energy, and justice. Devotees arrive especially for Tuesday seva and mangal-dosha shanti, seeking steadiness in marriage vows and life force. Local memory holds the shrine as ancient; modern seva revived it after decades of neglect.
